settings.autoApproveNote: Every request is approved and added to the library instantly — no review queue — and downloads right away, whoever requested it. Off = roles with “Manage requests” approve or decline each one; an approval downloads only when the approver has Search & download.
settings.westernOnlyNote: Only volumes from Western (US/UK) publishers can be searched and requested — manga and foreign-language titles are hidden. Uses a publisher allowlist.
settings.noCollectionsNote: Hide and block collected editions — trade paperbacks, hardcovers, omnibuses, “Complete” collections and the like — so only single-issue series can be requested. Detected from the volume’s title and description (the catalog has no format field), so it catches the vast majority but isn’t perfect.
settings.noComicsNote: Comics can’t be searched or requested. Requests already made stay in the queue.
settings.noBooksNote: Books can’t be searched or requested. Requests already made stay in the queue.
settings.noAudiobooksNote: Audiobooks can’t be searched or requested. Requests already made stay in the queue.
